note: Magnific Popup is a field formatter with no configure route. Its state is the field's display component in core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode>: component type 'magnific_popup' plus settings thumbnail_image_style, popup_image_style, gallery_type (all_items|first_item|separate_items), vertical_fit. Medium cases create an image field on Article, set its magnific_popup formatter to a known config, and the agent reads it back with drush cget; hard cases create the field with a non-magnific or partial formatter and the agent must set the formatter/settings, verified against the live entity_view_display. Image styles thumbnail/medium/large are core defaults.

evals.prompt: On a Drupal site with the Magnific Popup module, what is the machine id of the field formatter it provides for image fields, and on which entity configuration page do you select it?
evals.expected_output: The formatter id is magnific_popup (targets the core 'image' field type). You select it as the field's format on the entity's Manage display page; there is no separate settings/configure route.

evals.prompt: The Magnific Popup image formatter has a 'gallery type' setting. What are its possible values and what does each do?
evals.expected_output: gallery_type is one of all_items (all thumbnails shown, grouped into one gallery), first_item (only the first thumbnail is visible but the popup galleries through all), or separate_items (each item is an independent popup, no gallery).

evals.prompt: Can Magnific Popup open embedded videos (YouTube/Vimeo) in a lightbox on a Drupal site, and what is required for that?
evals.expected_output: Yes - the module also ships the video_embed_field_magnific_popup formatter for video_embed_field fields, which is only available/usable when the Video Embed Field contrib module is installed.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an image field field_mfp_gal that uses the Magnific Popup formatter on its default display. Inspect the live display configuration and tell me which gallery type is configured for that formatter.
evals.expected_output: The field_mfp_gal component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default uses type magnific_popup with settings.gallery_type = first_item.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an image field field_mfp_sty rendered with the Magnific Popup formatter. Inspect the live display configuration and tell me which image style is used for the popup (large) image.
evals.expected_output: The field_mfp_sty component in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default uses type magnific_popup with settings.popup_image_style = large (thumbnail_image_style = thumbnail).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has an image field field_mfp_task that currently uses the default image formatter on its default view display. Reconfigure that display so the field is rendered with the Magnific Popup formatter, grouped as a single gallery of all items. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the field_mfp_task component type to magnific_popup with settings.gallery_type = all_items.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article image field field_mfp_task2 already uses the Magnific Popup formatter (all-items gallery, original popup image). Change it so the popup opens the image at the 'large' image style and each item is shown as a separate popup rather than a gallery. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default the field_mfp_task2 magnific_popup component gets settings.popup_image_style = large and settings.gallery_type = separate_items.
